description: Create a checkout session: a payment link a PERSON opens and pays in their own USDC wallet (Base or Solana), for when you cannot sign a payment yourself or the user wants to pay with their own wallet. Pick the service with search_catalog or recommend_service and price it with get_quote first, then call this with service_id, quantity and link. The result carries page_url (give it to the person), the exact amount, expires_at (the price is held until then, 30 minutes by default) and a token for get_checkout_status. Creating a session moves no money and reserves nothing: nothing is charged until the person signs in their wallet, and an unpaid session simply expires. Each call opens a NEW session, so call it once per intended order and reuse the token you were given. Prefer create_paid_order when you hold a wallet and should pay yourself.

external_ref.description: Optional reference of your own (an order or conversation id, at most 128 characters), echoed by get_checkout_status.

link.description: The target link the order is delivered to.

return_url.description: Optional https URL shown to the person as a link after paying (where they came from). Never followed by the server.

service_id.description: The service: its id or its slug (e.g. telegram-members) from search_catalog or get_service. May be omitted when service_option_id is given, since an option names its service.

service_option_id.description: The plan option: the full id from options[].id in get_service or search_catalog. Optional: without it the service's primary option is priced. Alone, it also names the service.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional: hold the price for LESS than the default 30 minutes. A larger value is clamped to the default, never granted.

name: create_checkout
